name: m4-asf-ab
description: Timing A/B for a fast path in `Types.asSeenFrom`: return the type unchanged for `tp.asSeenFrom(C.this, C)` when no class on `C`'s owner chain has a self type refining it and `tp` has no annotated type or type variable (`PROPOSAL-asseenfrom.md`, branch `claude/asseenfrom-fastpath-d7ef00`). Instrumented counts on the scala corpus: 46% of the calls that reach `AsSeenFromMap` (2.0M of 4.3M) are of this shape, mostly `TypeRef#baseType` -> `relativize` for cake-pattern types such as `Global.this.Symbol`; scalap: 31% of far fewer.

Release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap, no profiler. Builds alternate fork by fork over 10 rounds; scala: single-shot 4+4 ops; scalap: 20+20 x 2 s. The JIT pilot `m4-asf-jit` showed no inlining shift around `asSeenFrom` beyond its A/A, so the ceiling variant (proto without the annotation / type-variable scan) was dropped.

variantDescriptions.proto: `4cf53d18e2` (the checkout head adds only `PROPOSAL-asseenfrom.md`): skip `AsSeenFromMap` for `C.this` seen from `C` (exact guard)
